claims.statement: The source registry expands to 20 unique logical sources.
Exact replay produces no second ledger effect in the local evidence implementation.
The controlled local failure laboratory passes all retained scenarios.
Card-security fields are rejected recursively before Lambda raw persistence.
Settlement processing uses a server-side copy of the exact S3 object version that passed checksum validation.
Only the currently active settlement revision and manifest hash can open a finance publication gate.
Finance current-state views exclude every transaction carrying a business exception.
The AWS reference architecture is sized for a modeled 10 million arrivals per day.
The repository does not claim an executed AWS deployment or cloud benchmark.
